message: 姉妹談義

name: Misa
message: 「Shio~」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister, I have been awaiting your arrival」

name: Misa
message: 「You seem to be working pretty hard lately, don't you? I'm rooting for you at the tournament」

name: Shio
message: 「Th-Th-That is, um...」

name: Shio
message: 「E-Elder Sister! Today, you see, I came to ask something of you, relying on your perspective as a woman...」

name: Misa
message: 「I've been a woman from the very beginning!」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I did not mean it in any such twisted way!」

name: Shio
message: 「It is simply that... one such as myself... does not truly comprehend what it means to be a woman...」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well!! If it's a request from my adorable little sister」

name: Misa
message: 「As long as it's within what I can answer, I'm sure I can give you some advice. Tell me」

name: Shio
message: 「You have my gratitude... In truth, I wish to humbly request your instruction on what brings joy to boys」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh... Could it be that you...」

name: Shio
message: 「N-No! It is merely to repay a debt of gratitude for all the care I constantly receive! Nothing more than that, I assure you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, Shio... Getting all bashful like this. You must have found someone you like」

name: Misa
message: 「I see. Things that make boys happy, huh... Have you at least gone on a date with him?」

name: Shio
message: 「A-A daaate!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Judging by that reaction, I guess not yet」

name: Shio
message: 「S-Such a thing as going on a date... h-how could I possibly...」

name: Misa
message: 「Rather than trying to please him right away, I think it's better to gradually close the distance between you two first」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmmmm... As expected of a master of romance」

name: Misa
message: 「I haven't been on nearly enough dates to be called a master, though」

name: Misa
message: 「There's a nice place in Ryuusei Town. Why don't you treat him there as a token of your thanks?」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I see... So you mean inviting him to a meal, then.」

name: Misa
message: 「No. A full meal is a bit too forward. Let's see, going out for tea would be just right, wouldn't it?」

name: Shio
message: 「If it is tea you speak of, I always have some humble tea of my own prepared...」

name: Misa
message: 「Not that kind of tea! It means chatting while eating sweets at a stylish cafe」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I see」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, just getting tea is something even regular friends can do...」

name: Misa
message: 「As your big sister, I have to give you solid advice so my little sister's romance succeeds」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's see... All you need now is one final trump card and it'll be perfect!」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh!! And what secret technique might that be!?」

name: Misa
message: 「...A k-k-k-kiss.」

name: Shio
message: 「Wh-What did you say!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yes. Once you kiss them, any boy will fall head over heels for you」

name: Shio
message: 「I-I see... Is a 'date' really something where one goes that far...」

name: Shio
message: 「Wait, that is impossible! Something like a kiss, for one such as myself...」

name: Misa
message: 「Though, a kiss might still be a little too early for you, Shio.」

name: Misa
message: 「--Not that I've ever done it myself, though」

name: Shio
message: 「What nonsense do you speak! E-Even I can... Mmmph...!」

name: Misa
message: 「You don't have to push yourself. Just holding hands is sure to make you feel happy」

name: Shio
message: 「Do not treat me like a child! I-I... have already had my chest touched, you know!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Eeeh!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Therefore, if it is merely a kiss... Urgh, I shall prove I can manage at least a kiss!」

name: Shio
message: 「Pardon me!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, wait just a second!」

name: Misa
message: 「Geez... she really hates to lose. I wonder who she takes after」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, Shio's started thinking about things like that too, huh. I can't afford to lose either!」

name: Misa
message: 「Even so... who could the person Shio likes be...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait, a relationship where someone's touching her boobs...\s03」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh--!? Have I... already lost!?」
